newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet diffs stable amid plentiful supply.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet diffs stable amid plentiful supply.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices edged higher with NYMEX futures Tuesday, although differentials held steady amid plentiful supply, players said.

New York Harbor aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was offered at 1.70 cents over July futures, steady with Monday diffs, with little action seen. "There's just too much supply in the harbor so nobody's in a hurry to buy. Everyone's gone fishing," one bored trader said.
Gulf 54-grade was also stable in similarly paltry activity, with offers at about 0.40 cent over July futures, players said.
